about: Ravita Engineering Services (formerly Powermech Services) provides turnkey engineering, procurement, installation and commissioning (EPIC) of HVAC, chiller plants and related electro-mechanical systems, plus O&M services, for onshore commercial and industrial sites, offshore oil and gas rigs and platforms, and data centres. It also executes a sub-sea effluent pipeline project for Numaligarh Refinery in Odisha. It had about 399 employees and an order book of Rs 491.12 crore at June 30, 2026.
sector: Engineering Services (HVAC / Electro-mechanical EPIC and O&M)

other.name: Top five customers share of revenue

objects.purpose: Capital expenditure for purchase of heavy equipment
General corporate purposes (capped at lower of 15% of gross proceeds or Rs 10 crore)

promoters.background: Promoters acquired 100% of the company in February 2025; Vibhoar Agrawal (40) is Chairman, with a long engineering/EPC background. MD and CEO Sunildutt Narayan Goswami has been with the company since 2010.

concentration.note: Top five customers were 78.65% of FY26 revenue (82.85% in Q1 FY27) and the largest customer 26.99%; top two projects are 31.90% of the order book.

litigation_note: Contingent liabilities (claims not acknowledged as debt) of Rs 4.47 crore at June 30, 2026. Promoter-group entity M.R. Foods is under RoC strike-off, which could disqualify promoter Vibhoar Agrawal as a director.
strengths: Offers both EPIC project execution and recurring O&M services, covering HVAC and electro-mechanical systems across the asset lifecycle.
Revenue grew from Rs 13.49 crore in FY24 to Rs 277.63 crore in FY26 with PAT of Rs 28.04 crore and about 10% PAT margin.
Order book of Rs 491.12 crore at June 2026 is about 1.8 times FY26 revenue, giving visibility.
Experience in offshore oil and gas platforms and mission-critical data centres, with new data centre orders worth Rs 120 crore.
Large in-house workforce of about 399 (368 engineering and technical) enables multi-site execution.
Repeat clients contributed 62.60% of FY26 revenue, including large PSU and corporate customers.
ROCE of 48.65% and RoNW of 48.90% in FY26 on reported basis.
Bid book of Rs 1,407.40 crore pending award at June 30, 2026 supports future order inflow.

risks.title: Very high customer concentration
risks.detail: Top five customers were 78.65% of FY26 revenue and 82.85% in Q1 FY27; the largest customer was 26.99% of FY26 revenue.

risks.title: Negative operating cash flow as receivables balloon
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was -Rs 8.94 crore in FY25 and -Rs 46.85 crore in FY26; trade receivables rose to Rs 73.26 crore and inventories to Rs 37.43 crore by March 2026.

risks.title: Large order book concentrated in few projects
risks.detail: Order book of Rs 491.12 crore comprises 21 projects; the top two projects are 31.90% of it, so delays could hurt results.

risks.title: Heavy dependence on working capital and IPO money
risks.detail: Rs 70 crore of the fresh issue funds working capital, and net working capital gap reached Rs 126.10 crore at June 2026, funded by borrowings and equity placements.

risks.title: Recent change in promoters and management
risks.detail: Current promoters acquired 100% of the company only in February 2025; business strategies and policies may change and track record under them is short.

risks.title: Promoter-group entity facing strike-off
risks.detail: M.R. Foods Private Limited, a promoter-group company, is under compulsory RoC strike-off, which may disqualify promoter Vibhoar Agrawal as a director.

risks.title: Significant related-party dealings
risks.detail: Related-party loans were large, for example Rs 12.50 crore in FY25 and FY26 with a promoter, and Q1 FY27 rent expense to a common-director entity was Rs 11.10 crore (11.41% of revenue).

risks.title: Very rapid growth, short track record and high attrition
risks.detail: Revenue rose from Rs 13.49 crore to Rs 277.63 crore in two years; employee attrition was 62.82% in FY26 and 82.03% in FY24, and contingent liabilities are Rs 4.47 crore.

notes: Standalone restated figures (no subsidiaries mentioned); amounts converted from Rs lakhs. FY24 operating cash flow 0.17 = 17.32 lakhs. Q1 FY27 (June 30, 2026) stub ignored in arrays: revenue Rs 97.31 crore, PAT Rs 10.13 crore. Price band, issue size, P/E and NAV after issue are blank in the RHP. Fresh issue shares 1,03,62,000 of face value Rs 5; post-issue promoter holding 52.92% computed from promoter shares over post-issue shares assuming full subscription. Reservation: anchor is up to 60% of the QIB portion (30% of net issue); QIB not more than 50%, NII not less than 15%, retail not less than 35% of net issue, plus a market maker portion of 5,22,000 shares. PAT margin and EBITDA margin are as reported (PAT margin on total income). Debt/equity and ROCE as reported. No listed peers per RHP.
